messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — the staged deploy yesterday hit a config edge case and cascaded to ~30% errors for ~20m. We need concrete remediation: auto-rollback, tighter blast-radius caps, explicit rollout owners. The offending change was a bad default that flipped canary to 50%.

devon: +1. Proposed action items: 1) auto-rollback when error_rate > 5% sustained for 3m; 2) default staged deploy max = 10% unless explicit approval; 3) push canary telemetry to oncall channel. I can own 1 & 2.

samir: I can own telemetry and dashboards. Will add composite alerts and a canary panel. Also suggest canary minimum duration floor = 15m to avoid noisy short blips.

lex: We should also add pre-deploy schema & config validation (fail fast), KV-cache warm checks, and a model-variant compatibility check. If those fail, block the rollout.

marta: Assigning owners here so we have dates: devon -> rollout guardrails PR, due 2026-04-01; samir -> telemetry + dashboards, due 2026-03-28; lex -> prechecks + runbook updates, due 2026-03-30. I will track these in the postmortem follow-up doc and surface at weekly ops sync.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-18-42 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood/pmo/INC-2026-03-18-42

devon: Draft auto-rollback config (pseudocode):
```
auto_rollback:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.05
  sustained_window_secs: 180
  min_canary_instances: 1
  exempt_labels: ["manual-approved"]
```
I'll open a PR tomorrow for runtime + API changes.

samir: For telemetry I'll add a composite SLO called `canary_health` (canary_error_rate + latency_p95). Alert routing: pager -> primary oncall -> eng-oncall slack bridge. Will add playbook snippets.

lex: Runbook checklist update: quick rollback command + validation steps. Quick command: `rl rollback --service deploy-service --to-tag stable` and a healthcheck post-rollback.

marta: Two small process asks: 1) surface `max_canary` in the deploy UI for oncall visibility; 2) add a per-team feature-flag policy doc (default caps, approval flow). Both quick but high impact.

devon: I'll change the UI + api to cap default to 10% and gate higher percentages behind an approvals endpoint. Exceptions require signed approval and audit log.

samir: Noting a recurring pattern: in the last 6 incidents, 4 had staged deploys with >25% canary or missing prechecks. I'll pull the incident list and drop into this thread by EOD. We should schedule a deeper pattern review if that holds.

devon: PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/4827 (auto-rollback + default max enforcement). Please review.

marta: Thanks — I'll add owners + due dates to the follow-up tracker and ping for updates in next ops sync. If anyone hits blockers, call it out here. :thumbsup:
